Use the game's hints: If you get stuck on a level, don't be afraid to use the game's hint feature. This will give you a subtle nudge in the right direction, helping you to solve the puzzle and progress through the game.

Focus on one puzzle at a time: With multiple puzzles to solve, it can be easy to get overwhelmed. Focus on one puzzle at a time, working through each level slowly and carefully. This will help you to stay focused and avoid getting frustrated with the game.

Practice makes perfect: As with any puzzle game, practice is key. Don't get discouraged if you don't solve a puzzle on the first try – keep trying until you get it right. With time and practice, you'll become a pro at solving puzzles and navigating the game's levels.
